name: Gas-fired and gas-conversion circulating fluidized bed boiler
description: Circulating fluidized bed boiler in which fine solids are suspended in a high-velocity gas stream and circulated through a cyclone or U-beam collector back to the furnace. Commercial CFB lines from the OEMs read are dominated by solid and multi-fuel designs; natural-gas firing is evidenced as a solid-fuel-to-gas conversion offering and as gas firing in a circulating-bed alumina calciner, not as a dedicated gas-fired boiler product.

specifications.basis: B&W IR-CFB product specifications: 2.2 million lb/h (277 kg/s) or greater as required
B&W: 'as required, usually to 1050 F (566 C)'
Valmet: boilers from 30 to 1,200 MWth (solid/multi-fuel range)
ANDRITZ PowerFluid Waste CFB: 50-200 t/h steam (40-150 MW)
EPA technology overview: about 10-30 ft/s for CFB versus 2-12 ft/s for conventional FBC; historical report, not a current guarantee

specifications.metric: natural-gas NOx in circulating fluid bed calciner
specifications.basis: EPA report: 40 ppm NOx achieved with natural gas firing in a Lurgi circulating fluid bed alumina calciner at up to 2,650 F; this is NOT a steam boiler
